ideas.pitch: An interactive dashboard visualizing real-time Parker Solar Probe telemetry and predicting geomagnetic disruptions affecting regional power grids.
ideas.title: Parker-Vswr: Solar Wind Anomaly & Flare Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly matches the winning formula of earth-wind-and-flare by processing complex NASA open heliophysics data into an intuitive, high-impact display for judges.

ideas.pitch: A spatial web dashboard simulating regional flora and fauna population dynamics under climate change scenarios using NASA Earth observation datasets.
ideas.title: EcoSpecies-Raipur: Local Ecosystem Biodiversity Digital Twin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning blueprint of Eco_Track by providing localized public awareness and simulation analytics on top of rigorous environmental data.

ideas.pitch: A predictive analytics platform combining NASA surface meteorology data with local grid telemetry to forecast urban cooling loads and prevent blackouts.
ideas.title: GridPulse-Sat: Satellite-Powered HVAC & Energy Demand Forecasting
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages heavy demand-forecasting concepts from AURA-AI-HVAC-Intelligence combined with NASA's open climate data to show concrete economic and social impact.

ideas.pitch: A full-stack mapping tool linking regional coal and mineral extraction sites to local power generation plants using satellite imagery and federal mining datasets.
ideas.title: MineToGrid: NASA Earth Observation Supply Chain Tracer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes the 'data nobody else had' winning pattern by integrating hard-to-source geospatial data feeds into an easily digestible intelligence map.

ideas.pitch: A commuter and freight carbon-emission visualization engine that contrasts ground travel footprints with optimized satellite-routed logistics data.
ideas.title: CarbonRoute-Space: Orbital vs. Terrestrial Carbon Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds directly upon the proven track-record of open-hack by elevating standard carbon-tracking metrics into multi-modal spatial intelligence.
